svg.text: BOOTHMUL — radix-4 Booth encoding, Dadda tree, final adder
sel = (negate, x2, non-zero) from the triplet: 000/111 -> 0,
row is the bitwise complement; the corrector adds the missing
+1s (neg_bits) as one extra row. The tree's register splits the
multiply into two cycles; final_add adds tree_c(31..0) and
tree_s(31..0): the product is the low 32 bits.
